 "data": "flowchart TD
 A([Start]) --> B[Open DFSS Application]
 B --> C{User Registered?}

 C -->|No| D[Register Account]
 D --> E[Login]

 C -->|Yes| E

 E --> F{Credentials Valid?}
 F -->|No| G[Show Login Error]
 G --> E

 F -->|Yes| H[Open User Dashboard]

 H --> I{Select Action}

 I -->|Upload File| J[Choose File]
 J --> K[Validate File]
 K --> L{File Valid?}

 L -->|No| M[Show Validation Error]
 M --> H

 L -->|Yes| N[Create File Metadata]
 N --> O[Split File into Chunks]
 O --> P[Generate SHA-256 Hash]
 P --> Q[Select Available Storage Nodes]
 Q --> R[Store Chunk Replicas]
 R --> S[Save Chunk Location Metadata]
 S --> T[Show Upload Success]
 T --> H

 I -->|Download File| U[Select File]
 U --> V[Find File and Chunk Metadata]
 V --> W[Retrieve Chunks from Nodes]
 W --> X[Verify Chunk Hashes]
 X --> Y{Chunks Valid?}

 Y -->|No| Z[Retrieve Replica or Show Error]
 Z --> H

 Y -->|Yes| AA[Reassemble Chunks in Order]
 AA --> AB[Download Original File]
 AB --> H

 I -->|Delete File| AC[Select File]
 AC --> AD[Delete Chunks from Nodes]
 AD --> AE[Delete Metadata]
 AE --> AF[Show Delete Success]
 AF --> H

 I -->|Logout| AG[Logout]
 AG --> AH([End])",
 "config": null
